title: Boolean embedding in sign coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a function from the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$. Encode its inputs as binary vectors and its outputs as elements of $\\mathbb{F}_2$, then map an output to $1$ if it is $1$ and to $0$ otherwise. When expressed back on the sign cube, the resulting real-valued function at $x$ is $(1-f(x))/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps the sign cube of dimension $n$ to the two signs $-1$ and $1$
